episode_row: bpm missing from inference: every tick crashed; 4/30 pick never locked/posted

commits.subject: fix(predict): wire batter_pitcher_shrunk_hr through inference path
commits.body:
bpm was promoted to FEATURE_COLS on 2026-04-29 and is now baked into the
trained blend model (blend_2026-04-30.pkl), but the inference path in
predict() builds rows from a lookup dict and never populated bpm — so
every scheduler tick after the 2026-04-29 deploy crashed with:

  Prediction failed: "['batter_pitcher_shrunk_hr'] not in index"

The pick file from morning's 3 AM cron carried PROJECTED-lineup picks
forward unchanged, never locked, never posted to Bluesky.

Fix:
1. _build_feature_lookups: build a (batter_id, pitcher_id) → bpm dict
   from the historical frame's last value per pair (~500K entries on
   prod 2026 data).
2. predict(): populate row["batter_pitcher_shrunk_hr"] from the lookup,
   falling back to the league prior 0.2195 for new matchups (matches
   compute.py's fillna(_PRIOR_RATE) behavior).

Sanity-checked on real data: lookup populated, fallback returns 0.2195,
all existing predict tests still pass.
